name: The Mechanics Albury
description: Workshop on North Street offering complete vehicle servicing for all makes and models of cars, 4WDs and SUVs across the Albury Wodonga region. Services include logbook servicing for new and used cars, NSW roadworthy certificates covering both pink and blue slips, and tyre replacement with wheel alignments.
highlights: Logbook servicing for new and used cars
NSW pink slip and blue slip inspections

name: Cartech Australia
description: Spencer Street workshop handling general and logbook servicing, mechanical repairs to brakes, batteries, radiators and clutches, and air conditioning servicing and repairs. Also carries out roadworthy certificates and vehicle inspections, 4WD diagnostic checks and servicing, and fleet maintenance for commercial vehicles. A VACC member holding ARC Tick AU39020 and repairer licence MVRL 53590.

name: Mid City Service Centre Albury
description: Family-owned workshop on Macauley Street offering general and logbook servicing, tyres, battery checks and replacement, NSW roadworthy inspections, diagnostics, brake and clutch repairs, and shock absorber and suspension work. The workshop is led by certified mechanic Jake Brown alongside another qualified mechanic and two apprentices. Student and pensioner discounts, a pick-up and drop-off service and AfterPay are offered.

name: Steve's Service Centre
description: Kaitlers Road workshop covering general servicing and maintenance, logbook servicing and NSW roadworthy certificates. Mechanical work extends to brake and clutch repairs, suspension, engine rebuilding, transmission and differential services, cooling systems, batteries, auto electrical repairs and exhaust systems. Repairer licence MVRL49046.

name: North Albury Automotive
description: Union Road workshop run by Matt, covering logbook servicing, diesel and petrol injector repairs and cleaning, brake and clutch repairs and electrical diagnostics. The workshop has a dynamometer for dyno tuning and performance checks, and carries out NSW pink slip and blue slip inspections along with full engine diagnostics.
highlights: Diesel and petrol injector repairs and cleaning
NSW pink slip and blue slip inspections

name: Go Automotive
description: Calimo Street workshop that also runs a fully licensed and insured mobile mechanic service, completing repairs at a customer's house or roadside. The business offers roadside assistance and mobile roadworthy certificate inspections for light vehicles, cars, trucks, caravans and trailers, along with eSafety checks. Mobile Eftpos payment via Tyro is available. Repairer licence MVRL 53896.
highlights: Mobile roadworthy inspections for cars, trucks, caravans and trailers

name: NG Mechanical Services
description: Thurgoona workshop on Ceres Drive offering general and logbook servicing alongside dyno tuning, engine conversions and fabrication with a Landcruiser focus. Other work includes air conditioning repairs, 4WD servicing and repairs, and dual battery design and installation. Repairer licence MVRL 61400.

name: Bartlett Automotive
description: Nurigong Street workshop trading since 2004, handling servicing, repairs and replacements, vehicle diagnostics, Victorian roadworthy certificates and NSW eSafety checks. The team works on European luxury cars, electric vehicles, 4WDs and diesel machines, carries out 4x4 modifications and retails 4x4 accessories and parts.
highlights: European luxury car and EV servicing
Vic roadworthy and NSW eSafety checks

name: Azzi & Nusser Service Centre
description: Family-owned and operated since 1969, this Mint Street service centre repairs and services most makes and models from old classics through to the latest vehicles, including new car warranty and logbook servicing. Work covers brake and clutch repair, air conditioner service, repair and re-gas, suspension repairs and upgrades, and wheel and tyre supply and fitting. A licensed Victorian vehicle tester, it issues Roadworthy Certificates.
highlights: New car warranty and logbook servicing
Air conditioning service, repair and re-gas

name: O'Neill's Autos
description: Thomas Mitchell Drive workshop covering mechanical repairs and logbook servicing for all makes and models, with 4x4 and diesel work a stated focus. Services include brake and clutch repairs, suspension work, transmission service, auto air conditioning maintenance, car batteries and pre-purchase vehicle inspections.

name: Gricey's Workshop Automotive Specialist
description: West Wodonga workshop on Trafalgar Street handling engine repair and diagnostics, logbook servicing and vehicle diagnostics. Other services include air conditioning servicing, tyres and suspension work, radiator and cooling system repairs, brake repairs, and transmission and exhaust repair for both manual and automatic transmissions.

name: Grealy Motors
description: Reid Street business combining 24-hour towing with a repair workshop. A tilt tray handles breakdown and accident towing as well as heavy towing, and the workshop covers servicing and repairs for all makes and models, logbook servicing, VicRoads roadworthy inspections, brakes, air conditioning, cooling systems, LPG vehicle repairs, tyres and wheel alignment, motorcycle repairs and minor smash repairs. Listed as an RACV Depot (#338), with Victorian Tow Operator Accreditation OA 0537 and NSW Towing Operator Licence 91053.
highlights: Tilt tray breakdown and accident towing
Motorcycle repairs and minor smash repairs

name: Crossborder Towing
description: Towing and vehicle transport operator established in 1964, running 24/7 towing for breakdowns, accidents and emergencies across Albury and surrounds. A car carrier service moves vehicles, caravans and boats, including interstate and Australia-wide transport. Depots are held at Macauley Street South Albury and Moulder Court Wodonga, with a separate car carrying line on 0407 215 399.
highlights: Car carrier for vehicles, caravans and boats
Depots in South Albury and Wodonga

name: Lavington Auto Electrical
description: Union Road auto electrician covering advanced diagnostics and fault finding, auto air conditioning service and regassing, battery sales and fitting, and alternator and starter motor repairs. The workshop also handles electronic fuel injection and ignition system repairs, security systems, agricultural equipment electrical work, general vehicle servicing and accessory fitting such as cruise control and reverse cameras. A mobile service operates within a 150 km radius. Arc Tick licence AU36293 and repairer licence MVRL54170.
highlights: Auto air conditioning service and regassing
Accessory fitting including cruise control and reverse cameras

name: A Plus Automotive Electrical
description: Wagga Road auto electrician handling auto air conditioning servicing, repairs and regassing plus auto electrical testing, diagnostics, repairs and replacements. Work extends beyond cars to caravans, marine electrical and electronics, and trucks, machinery and tractors. The business also sells and replaces batteries and installs accessories including LED lighting, bull bars, audio systems and roof racks.
highlights: Auto air conditioning repairs and regassing
Accessory fitting including LED lighting and bull bars

name: Hagan's Auto Electrical & Airconditioning
description: Auto electrical and air conditioning specialist serving Albury, Wodonga and surrounding areas from branches at Mulqueeney Street Wodonga and 547 Nurigong Street South Albury. The workshop covers cars, bikes, trailers, caravans, agricultural equipment, ATVs, forklifts, trucks, buses and mining machinery, and runs a 24/7 breakdown service on 0418 334 062.
highlights: Two branches: Wodonga and South Albury

name: North Albury Tyrepower & Mechanical
description: Urana Road store combining tyres, wheels, batteries and wheel alignments with a mechanical workshop. Tyre work includes fitting, balancing, puncture repairs, tyre recycling and nitrogen inflation, while the workshop handles log book servicing, brake, steering, suspension and clutch repairs, roadworthy inspections, 4WD lift kits and accessories, and camber and castor kits. Brands stocked include Dunlop, Michelin, Toyo, Goodyear, Cooper, BFGoodrich, Mickey Thompson, Pirelli, Falken and Yokohama.
highlights: Mechanical servicing and log book servicing
Wheel brands including CSA, ROH and Speedy Wheels

name: Tyrepower Wodonga
description: Watson Street store selling and fitting tyres, wheels and batteries with wheel alignment, balancing and puncture repairs. Qualified technicians also carry out mechanical servicing and repairs, suspension work, brake and rotor service, steering repairs and roadworthy inspections. A separate Tyrepower Wodonga Truck & Ag Centre at 2 Moulder Court, phone 02 6056 1403, covers agricultural, truck and industrial tyres and offers on-site farm service.
highlights: Separate Truck & Ag Centre at 2 Moulder Court

name: Panel Pro Smash Repairs
description: Owner-operated smash repair shop on Sanyo Drive run by Jake and his wife Katie, serving Albury-Wodonga. Work covers panel beating, dent removal, hail damage repair, spray painting, insurance smash repairs, rust repairs and rust sections, and fibreglass repairs.

name: Jacob Body and Paint
description: Melrose Drive smash repairer with over 40 years in the industry, covering panel repairs, paint restoration, smash repairs and vehicle damage assessment. The workshop is equipped with three Car-O-Liner measuring benches, Master spray booths, infrared drying equipment and multi-spot welders for repairs to manufacturer specifications.
highlights: Master spray booths and infrared drying

name: Wodonga Exhaust Centre
description: Reid Street exhaust and muffler shop selling and fitting mufflers, standard and sports exhaust systems, and building custom exhaust systems. The workshop also handles extractor replacements, machined manifolds and EPA sound testing, working on cars, trucks, buses and 4x4s as well as vintage cars, hot rods, muscle cars and classics.
highlights: Hot rod, muscle car and classic work

name: North Albury 4WD Centre
description: Urana Road 4WD shop supplying and installing suspension lift kits from Dobinsons, Raw 4x4, Tough Dog and EFS, including 2 inch lifts and higher options for added ground clearance. The centre is also a STEDI supplier and installer for LED driving lights, light bars and work lights, and stocks off-road recovery gear such as recovery tracks and snatch straps, with vehicle-specific installation.
highlights: Suspension lift kit supply and installation
Dobinsons, Raw 4x4, Tough Dog and EFS kits
STEDI LED lighting supply and installation

name: Wodonga Spring Works
description: Australian owned suspension specialist on High Street, in business for over 30 years and servicing the Albury Wodonga region. The workshop supplies and installs coil springs, leaf springs, torsion bars, shock absorbers and steering dampers, GVM and GCM suspension upgrades and lift kits, plus 4x4 components and bushes, trailer parts, bull bars, rear and side bars, light bars, recovery kits, winches, and caravan and motorhome suspension.
highlights: Coil springs, leaf springs and torsion bars
Bull bars, rear bars and side bars

name: Opposite Lock Albury Wodonga
description: Thomas Mitchell Drive 4x4 store and workshop selling and installing 4x4 accessories and carrying out 4x4 modifications. The mechanical side handles repairs and servicing, pre-trip inspections and diesel ECU remapping, and the associated Wodonga Autogas & 4WD Centre covers LPG conversions, repairs and servicing.

name: Wyatt Mechanical
description: Chisholm Court heavy diesel workshop covering truck repairs, earthmoving and machinery repairs, and hydraulic hose repairs and servicing. Other work includes ECU diesel remapping, brakes, transmission and clutch, routine servicing, cooling system repairs, fuel injection, diagnostics, exhausts and auto electrical. A mobile repair service supports customers on site.

name: Natrad Albury/Wodonga
description: Huon Street cooling specialist handling radiators, intercoolers and air conditioning systems for passenger cars through to trucks and heavy equipment. The team has over 40 years in the radiator and heat exchange industry and includes a licensed air conditioning technician (AU 03523). Radiator replacement carries a manufacturer-supported three year nationwide warranty, and a customer drop-off service is available.
highlights: Cars through to trucks and heavy equipment

name: Whitehouse Motorcycles
description: Young Street motorcycle dealership carrying Yamaha, Kawasaki, Suzuki, Triumph and Husqvarna along with pre-owned bikes. The service department is staffed by qualified, factory-trained Yamaha, Suzuki, Kawasaki and Triumph technicians offering logbook servicing, and a parts and accessories counter holds stock and orders in parts.
highlights: Factory-trained Yamaha, Suzuki, Kawasaki and Triumph technicians

name: Fast Fuel Motorcycles
description: Royal Enfield dealer on Wagga Road that has been trading in Albury-Wodonga since 2019. The workshop services all makes and models with a Harley-Davidson servicing specialty, supplies and fits tyres, and issues NSW roadworthy certificates. Parts, accessories and riding gear are stocked, and after-hours service drop-off and pick-up plus motorcycle pickup are offered.
highlights: Servicing for all makes and models

name: As-Nu Detailing
description: Sanyo Drive detailing shop whose Complete Detail covers wash, vacuum, interior shampooing, cut and polish, tyre painting and undercarriage treatment, with a Quick Clean option for lighter jobs. Interior protection is offered for seats, carpets, vinyl and leather, along with paint protection and FX ceramic coating. Free local pickup is available in the Albury Wodonga area, and the business prepares cars for weddings, sale, trade-in and lease return.
highlights: Complete Detail including cut and polish
FX ceramic coating and paint protection
Free local pickup in Albury Wodonga

name: Baileys Automotive Care
description: McDonald Road business combining car detailing and washing with window tinting for vehicles, homes and offices. Detailing covers full wash and wax, vehicle preparation for sale, leather cleaning and conditioning, paint reconditioning, engine degrease, pet hair removal and fleet detailing. Nilrust paint protection and SunTek automotive tints are offered, with a 30 day money-back guarantee on tinting and a lifetime warranty on most films.
highlights: Window tinting for cars, homes and offices
Lifetime warranty on most tint films
